_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Kamoe pemain {player_id} dalam Tic Tac Toe tiga pemain.
Simbol kamoe ialah '{symbol}'.
Kamoe bergiliran meletakkan simbol kamoe pada papan 5x5 untuk membentuk garis empat.
Garis bisa horizontal, vertikal, atau diagonal.
Kirimkan gerakan kamoe menggunakan format '[4]' untuk menandai sel 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Format langkah hana sah. Guna "[cell]" di pat sel 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nomor sel hana sah: {cell}. harus antara 0 dan {max_cell}.

game_action.placed: Pemain {player_id} meletakkan simbol mereka ({symbol}) di lapangan ({row}, {col}).
